body:
Collect each package's DDL under an owner, use Install to order the whole contribution set, then run the Script through the migration executor. Preserve the Statement flags instead of flattening the Script to SQL strings. This preserves foreign-key ordering and checks whose failure is expressed as returned rows.

Evidence: ds:block?id=migration-install-ennvmeq2; ds:block?id=schema-order-mc4m9j96; ds:block?id=ddl-contract-s2xdb9he; ds:block?id=migration-execute-hgdykxdq. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Assemble schema contributions before executing
